'''Torpedo attack carriers''' were underwater craft that were equipped with [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and acted as protective support for [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport]]s. During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], several torpedo attack carriers were stationed at the [[Underwater Zeta Zero Nine base|underwater base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeta Zero Nine]]. One such ship was commandeered by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] infiltrators and used to attack the underwater base. A bombardment of concussion missiles from the craft critically damaged the facility, causing the Imperial base to explode.<ref name="DH" />
